summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing its MD&A and interim financial statements for the quarter ended June 28, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure under Rule 13a-16, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. It reports operating performance in Canadian dollars and incorporates exhibits into existing registration statements. No deal terms, board actions, or unusual corporate events are mentioned. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
